item.title: Madonna & Anna Wintour Appear in ‘Confessions II’ Theatrical Promo Ahead of ‘Devil Wears Prada 2’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we dish out the latest in entertainment news. Today, we're talking about a legendary team-up that's got everyone buzzing. Madonna and Anna Wintour are joining forces to promote Madonna's upcoming album, Confessions II."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The two icons appear together in a 30-second teaser clip, screening in theaters ahead of The Devil Wears Prada 2. The footage shows them sitting side by side at a fashion show, with Madonna's 1990 hit 'Vogue' playing in the background."
[Clip of "Vogue" plays briefly]
Host: "In the clip, Wintour asks Madonna why they're still playing 'Vogue,' and Madonna responds with a sly 'because they miss me.' Wintour teases her about having something new, and Madonna reveals she has a confession to make... leading into her new single 'Bring Your Love,' featuring Sabrina Carpenter."
[Clip of "Bring Your Love" plays briefly]
Host: "The song is the lead single from Confessions II, due out July 3rd. The album is the follow-up to Madonna's 2005 hit Confessions on a Dance Floor. We can't wait to see what Madonna has in store for us. That's all for today, thanks for tuning in!"
[Outro music plays]
